text:
Anthropic has acquired Mithril Medicine, a one-person biotech developing treatments for rare muscular dystrophies.

Its founder used Claude to coordinate contracts, logistics and experiments with 11 external labs. Anthropic says one potential treatment went from an idea to promising results in mice in under 18 months.

A one-person company can still draw on a much larger network of expertise. The result is early: if the candidates continue to hold up, Anthropic expects one could be ready to start human trials as early as late 2028.

https://www.anthropic.com/research/early-progress-drug-development
